summary: Read VDD execution-plan skill; mandatory authority/reference reads precede action; standalone requirements file routes to direct implementation, while explicit complete-directory requests select create or repair; choose standard/resumable/self-hosted before model routing; route uses Sol/high except narrowly typed, capability-probed recovery; clarify only material scope, compatibility, destructive, protected-path, or acceptance boundaries; lifecycle is draft -> plan-ready -> implementation-authorized -> implementation-complete -> acceptance-passed -> archived; Quick Dev owns RED execution and implementation-complete, while VDD does not manufacture RED evidence; each slice needs behavior, failure intent, GREEN target, dependents, and recovery; repair is in-place, immutable history, bounded rounds, lineage and typed Round-3 triggers; repair requires root-cause callsite inventory, changed-set hashes, composition receipts, and complete generated review scope; mandatory knowledge preflight and skill-input consumption gates block plan-ready on invalid or unmatched required inputs; use explicit target paths and generated typed child requests; bind Git baseline and complete scoped identity; Bootstrap review is optional, minimal-complete-closure only, and historical evidence is non-authorizing; resumable/self-hosted require append-only 95 report/index; targeted checks cannot authorize completion; terminal current full validation is required before implementation-complete; package must remain generic and avoid live plan or machine-specific data.
